batting.name: DPMD Jayawardene
batting.dismissal: st Kamran Akmal b D Salunkhe

batting.name: B Lee
batting.dismissal: c Kamran Akmal b SK Trivedi

batting.name: M Kaif
batting.dismissal: c KC Sangakkara b S Sreesanth

batting.name: Kamran Akmal
batting.dismissal: c PP Chawla b JR Hopes

balls.text: yes it is a short one and Piyush pulls it to midwicket boundary.
he walked right across the stumps, moved early and Watson followed him with a full one outside off but he did well to paddle it past the short fine-leg fielder.
another bouncer, another swing, the ball rushes past the edge and to Akmal.  You could have bet that Watson would have bowled a short one. He loves them
fires in a bouncer, the pull shot was attempted but he made contact with the top half of the bat and it just popped over midwicket
full toss well outside off, Chawla reached out and tapped it past covers. No ball, though. Free hit coming up.
edged but the diving Akmal can't reach it. Full, angling across Piyush who tried to swing it the on side and got a thick profitable edge

Another wicket. It was sliced to deep backward point and he turned for the second run. But the throw was flat, straight and at Kamran Akmal who broke the stumps. No need for the third umpire to get in. Given out by the on-field umpire. He was that short.
another really full one, stabbed to third man and this time its just a single
lands it full and outside off stump, sliced past point and Munaf is unhappy with the wide third man fielder. He thinks there should be only one run there
full toss outside off stump and slashed over point. Now, that was a poor delivery.
full and straight, driven to long-off
fullish, outside off stump, driven to mid-off where its misfielded
this one is full one outside off, Piyush has a swing and gets a leading edge over covers
short one, slanted across the batsman, left alone
But gets his man this time. Follows the full one with a short rising delivery and Brett Lee top edges his intended upper cut.
dropped by Trivedi. Full, on the stumps, driven uppish back at Trivedi who swooped but couldn't hold on
Cleaned up by a yorker. He has served quite a few yorkers and well directed at that. Irfan had a big swing, the ball missed the bat but connected with the leg stump
full pitched, just short of the blockhole, driven to midwicket
flighted outside off stump, big turn away, tapped to backward point

Yuvraj, never a great player of good quality spin, has been done in by Warne. It was a loopy flighted one that was slightly slower in pace, and it broke back in from the off stump line. Yuvraj had gone for his favourite sweep - his get out shot in tough situations against spin- missed and was struck on the back leg
again comes out, almost yorks himself as Warne keeps it full this time but manages to squeeze it
charges down the track, Warne fires it short, Irfan adjusts and swings it high over midwicket ropes. Just over.
slows up the pace, keeps it full and Yuvraj waits before launching himself into that. The ball flies to right of long-on fielder who does well to make the stop
on the middle, turns in , flatter trajectory, turned to square leg
fires a quicker one, again Irfan can't put it away for a run.
full and straight, pushed to the off side
quicker one and Yuvraj top edges a pull but it lands safely between midwicket and deep midwicket
Another one on that very same spot. Full toss and Yuvraj sends the ball screaming over the stands. Yuvi is enjoying himself out there.
The white ball has begun to fly once again. Welcome to the attack Yusuf. Off break from round the stumps but Yuvraj just clears his front leg and swings it over midwicket. It again lands on the roof!
serves up a fiery yorker, right on the base of the middle stump, jabbed off the inner edge to the leg side
nice change of pace. Yuvi is the one who is beaten this time. Excellent over, this.
fullish, driven in the air and just one bounce to the long-off fielder. And somone shouts out, "jaana aage"! (Move forward) to the fielder. Good advice.
comes down the track and is confronted with a yorker outside off and he can't connect
wild swing and a miss. Offcutter outside off stump and Irfan was very early into his slog
leans forward to drive to the off side
shorter, turns in  and Pathan goes back to steer to point
loopy delivery outside off ,squeezed to point
comes down the track, is done in by the flight but manages to get his body behind it and tucks it behind square
stays round the stumps, flings a full one across, too full and Yuvi drives through wide mid-off
fuller, quicker, flatter, guided to backward point
Fiddler on the roof! It was pretty short and Yuvraj pulled it high, up and over and it kept flying and landed on the roof over deep midwicket
bangs it short, Pathan fails to connect with his pull

dropped by Kaif. It was full and outside off, sliced to right of Kaif, at backward point, but he was moving to his left and the slice fooled him there. IT swung away from him and he did get both palms to it but it just bursts through his hands.
slower one, short and outside off, Yuvraj swatted it to short midwicket
well-directed bouncer and a surprised Yuvraj just about ducks away
length delivery, just outside off stump, punched to sweeper cover
Delicious whack through covers. He made room for himself and connected a cover drive. The ball just raced through the field. Wonderful timing.
bad delivery - down the leg side and short too, lapped around the corner, past short fine leg
driven to extra cover for a single
The stumps are down. But at the other end. Yuvi drilled a fullish delivery straight back and the ball ricocheted off the stump and thudded into Aleem Dar's right leg
a touch short in length, cut through covers
short in length, angled across Yuvraj who inside edges a cut
pushed it through from the front of the hand and it slid across Pathan who went for a cut and was beaten. Warne is unleashing his bag of tricks. Fab show.
the slider outside off and Yuvraj drove to long-off
rips across a legbreak, full and outside off, Yuvraj stretches across to defend
low full toss and driven to long on

dropped by Lehmann. What a dolly it was too. Oh the agony for Warne. A topspinner outside off stump, Yuvraj though it would turn in, went for his sweep  and topedged a dolly high to covers where Lehmann stationed himself, got under the ball and clanged it.
hits the deck short of length, on the middle and Pathan defends down the track
bangs in a bouncer, at least he got that one head-high and the batsman goes down under
fuller and on the off stump line, driven to long-off
down the leg side now and Yuvraj helps it around the corner, to the fine-leg boundary
There we go again. Watson and his penchant for the short one. Yuvraj just hopped up and pulled it to deep backward square leg region
starts off with a yorker on the leg stump line, Yuvraj tries to dig it out, misses and is hit on the pad. Watson appeals but turned down. Close call.

Warne does it with a topspinner! It landed on length, on the off stump line and straightened, Hopes, again, went for his slog, missed and was struck on the line of off stump. Whether it would have turned a little and missed off was the question. the umpire was convinced there was enough over spin for the ball to slide through straight and raised his finger
spins from the middle stump line, Hopes wanted to drive it through covers and edged it to short third man
quicker one but short in length and Yuvi pulls it to deep midwicket
leans forward to ping the long-on for a single
flighted it outside off, slowed up the pace, Hopes seems to like his slog across the line but again, doesn't connect
full in length, on the middle, driven to mid-on
again spinning on to the pad and it runs off the pad

Drama! The bowler and the 'keeper celebrate, thinking they got a catch down the leg side but Aleem Dar calmly signalled it a wide. It spun down the leg side, Yuvraj tried to glance it and it appeared as if he missed it. The replays, pretty bad angle, doesn't say much.
Yuvi starts off with a neat straight drive. It was overpitched, from round the stumps and Yuvi drove it straight past the bowler.

Salunkhe, the winner of the Mumbai leg of the reality show Cricket Star, has got rid of Mahela. Lovely loopy flighted one had Mahela charging out for a big hit but it spun past the ambitious swing of the bat. Stumped. Salunkhe is ecstatic and lets out a huge roar of joy
flighted one full and Hopes went for a almighty slog across the line and edged it through the vacant slip region.
a touch short and pulled past midwicket
bowled leg spin there. A touch outside off and Mahela can't connect with his cut shot
swept past square leg
slows up the pace but lands it slightly short and it's cut to deep point
on the off and middle line, slight turn and guided to point

Warne gets his first wicket of the tournament. He flighted it full outside off, Sangakkara tried to thrash it down the ground, the bat-face shut a touch and Warne was in the way. He took the catch and calmly threw the ball away. As if he expected a return catch. The magician is at his tricks again
lands it on the leg and middle, slight turn and its squeezed behind squareleg
a touch short in length, spins in, pulled to long-on
He charges out, the bowler slips in a slower one but short in length and Sanga arrests his forward press, stops and flat-bats it through mid-on
hurls a bouncer and Sangakkara ducks. Warne is warming up.
Full again and Sangakkara drills it past the diving mid-on fielder
a slower one but an unfazed Sanga picked it up early and sent it over mid-on.
Sanga goes downtown. A fab effort too. He just leaned forward and knifed it on the up and over long-off. He made that look pretty easy.
on the middle and leg, turned behind square for a single.
Fullish and its wristed through the on-side field for yet another boundary
A fab yorker and Munaf exacts his revenge. It was fired in the blockhole and on the base of the off stump, Goel tried to bring his bat down in a hurry. Too late. Death knell.
the attempted yorker goes awry. It ended up as a full toss and Goel just killed it over long-off. Lovely swing of the bat.
Munaf pitches it short of length and Goel sends it over midwicket.
low full toss, driven hard but again straight to mid-off. 24 for 0.
full in length, around the off stump, driven to mid-off
cuts but straight to backward point
Watson continues to bowl lots of short deliveries and Hopes dismissed this one over square leg. Cracking pull shot.
He is going hard at everything now. Short of length, outside off and he tried to flay it through point and gets a bottom edge on to it
fuller and Hopes drives but goes too hard at it and the ball rolls over towards mid-on
short in length, outside off, steered to point
Hit on the up. A touch short of length, outside the off stump and Hopes hits on the up through wide mid-off
full in length, outside off, Goel drives, misses and Munaf appeal for a caught behind dismissal.
Shot boss! It was short in length and Goel swivelled to play a thrilling pull over the ropes
fullish, driven to mid-on
jumps out and lofts the delivery over mid-off, just one bounce over the ropes. Goel is up and running.
another one pitched short and a weak flat-batted swat to the leg side is attempted
another well-directed bouncer, Goel goes for the pull, again a touch late but manages to get it down to fine leg
beaten. Rushing through the channel outside off and Goel pushes inside the line.
Watson, as is his wont, bangs the ball in and Goel is late on the pull. The ball just rolled over to the leg side and Watson lets Goel know that he was in trouble there
leans forward to punch a length delivery in the air towards mid-off
The first four of the evening. Full and drifting on to the legs, Goel flicked it uppishly to fine-leg boundary
Tight over comes to an end. It was on the off stump line and Hopes defended it to the off side
and again Yusuf Pathan is in the picture. Another dive and a throw but he misses the stumps and the batsman scampers home in time.
on the middle stump line, turned to midwicket,  Hopes wanted a single but Yusuf Pathan fired in a throw and Hopes dived back into the crease
leans across to defend a length delivery to the off side
full and well outside the off stump, left alone. Quiet start
start.
Watto pulls off the win with a fierce pull shot to midwicket boundary. His team-mates celebrate at the dug out and so does the crowd. The fireworks are on as well. The Jaipur sky is being lit up.
gets his yorker right this time, jabbed to the on side, through mid-on region
similar delivery, on the middle this time and driven towards Irfan at long-on
goes for a yorker, falls just short of the target area, whipped past square leg.
keeps it full and straight, Jadeja drives down the ground for a single
change of pace, outside off, cut down to third man where Sreesanth fumbles and they get across for the second run
down the leg side,. yet another wide.
full pitched, on the middle, driven to long on
goes round the stumps, another slower one but short in length and is cut to deep point
short pitched delviery and that's the one for the over

stays where he is and guides a slower one to backward point where Goel dives to field. The batsmen hesitate about the single, Goel fires but misse. Had he hit, Watson would have been stranded. He had given up
quicker and closer to the off stump, Jadeja has another swing and a miss. Watson again comes down for a chat
yet another slower one, Jadeja is too early into his waft and Sanga gathers
Jadeja tries the same thing with Irfan who like Lee, bowls a slower one and Jadeja watches it sail past the off stump
For variety, he moves outside off now and shovels a full and straight delivery over square leg
Ah! but he does it again and pulls off a boundary. This time, he moved late and not too much down leg and just opened the bat-face to guide a full delivery through backward point
deja-vu. Jadeja moved down leg again, Lee sends across a slower one and it beats the waft and goes over the stumps. Lee has a few words with Jadeja and Watson comes down to have a chat with Jadeja.
moves down leg again, Lee bowls a slower one outside off and Jadeja fails to connect
full, fast, furious, almost at the base of the off stump but Jadeja moved outside leg, crouched, got his bat down in time and what's more placed it really fine to thirdman region. Very well adjusted
length delivery on the middle stump, worked to midwicket for a single
Sanga misses a stumping chance. Jadeja had charged down the track, missed a lofted shot but so did Sangakkara
And this one has disappeared over long-on. He heaved a full delivery over the ropes. The runs are coming thick and fast
Jadeja the boy from Saurashtra is giving great support to Watson. He leaned forward and swung a length one over midwicket
lands short of driveable length, turns away, dabbed to short third man

Watto is having a great night. Piyush continues to bleed. Flighted outside off and Watson drilled it really hard. It didn't go far to the left of long-on fielder but had no chance. That one was really travelling. The umpire has a doubt whether its six or four, refers upstairs and signals four
comes in with the round-the-stumps angle, punched through extra cover
No ball. Crowd are loving it. Short in length and it moves past the outside edge as Jadeja attempts another slash.

There comes the slash and the ball races to the deep backward point boundary. It was hurled across full in length from round the stumps, Jadeja moved to the leg side and whiplashed it through cover point.
short, at the body, short-arm pulled to deep midwicket
carves this length delivery past Sreesanth
digs it short of length, Jadeja opens up his stance and flat-bats it through covers. That was a fierce blow
short in length, backs away a touch to cut it but misses and the ball rushes over the stumps
full and down the leg side, Watto has a swing, misses and it runs off the pad
fuller and worked through wide midwicket.
Every hit seems to land on the roof. Low roofs here at the Sawai Man Singh stadium. Waston thrusts his front foot out and lauches himself into big drive over long on
Full and well outside off, Watson reaches out and drives in the air to right of sweeper cover where Goel makes a diving stop. 50 up for Watto
on a length, outside off, swatted to deep midwicket
fullish, on the middle, jabbed back past the bowler
full and outside off stump, mistimes a drive to covers, the throw comes in at the non-striker's end. Watson dives, the ball misses the stumps
He moves outside leg, flashes at a full length delivery on the middle, the bottom-hand comes off the handle and the ball flies off the outer edge over cover point
on the middle and punched to Yuvraj at covers
leans across to push it the off side
wide down the leg side

loud appeal and Aleem Dar has given it out. Crucial breakthrough. Full, curving in, Lehmann fails to connect with a intended across the line whip and was struck in front of leg. The Hawkeye suggests it would have clipped the leg stump.
Full, outside off, Lehmann tried to slog it out of the earth and misses it completely
leans forward to defend back to the bowler
Another one settles into the roof. It was short and allowed Watson to rock right back and pull it over the wide long-on region. Piyush Chawla is bleeding runs here.
on the middle, rushes on straight, Watson didn't pick it but played it off the pitch to midwicket
turns in this time and driven to long-off
the slider outside off, it angles away from Lehmann, who is a damn fine player of spin and he went back and across to cut it through backward point.
right up there, full, driven towards mid-off region for a single
beaten by the slower one. Lehmann didn't pick it at all, took out the bottom-hand off the handle and attempted at the last minute to slice it away but missed it
goes round the stumps, just outside off, angling in, tapped to backward point
fullish, outside off and Watson drills it through wide long-off region for a yet another boundary.  The crowd are up on their feet. They are loving this entertainment from their man.
short in length, outside off, Lehmann waits on the ball before late cutting it to third man.
rolls his fingers around the ball this time, sends across a off cutter which is dabbed to third man
Murder! He thrusted his front foot out and smoked a fierce drive in the air and past  a stunned Irfan! It almost took out Irfan
slower in pace, fuller and on the pads, Lehmann misses his flick and it rolls to the leg side off the pad. Hopes rushes across to pick it up
Lehmann breaks free with a fierce cut. He rocked back and across to cut a short-of-length delivery past point
on a length, on the off and middle, punched to Yuvraj at covers.
close to the off stump, short of length and Lehmann is cramped up and can't connect with his cut.
run down to third man.
Big heave over long-off. He went down on his knee, reached out to a full delivery outside off and slammed it high and over the boundary
edged but short of Sanga. It was slower in pace, off cutter and Watson followed the ball and it fell short and bounced awkwardly at Sanga
full and outside off, shapes away and Lehmann's plays his first convincing stroke of the evening - a fluent square drive past point. He is beginning to settle down
well outside off, Lehmann lets it go and has a look at the umpire who extends his arms.
fuller, outside off and Watson drives to long-off for a single
takes this one away and Watson is beaten as he pushes inside the line. THe previous one swung back in, this one has curved away.
swings in towards the middle and Watson just about manages to jab it away.
lands it on a length, on the off stump, Lehmann hands the strike to Watson with a wristy dab to square leg
change of pace, short in length, just outside off, he tries to work it to the leg side but no pace to work with
short in length, steered to backward point
short in length, outside off, wristed to Yuvraj  at midwicket
fuller, just outside off stump, stabbed to the off side.

OMG! The bat broke but the ball has flown over long-on boundary! Now, then, how often do you see that. Watson heaved a length delivery, the ball flew of the bat but so did half of bat itself. Hilarious!
around the off stump, nagging length and Lehmann gets a inside edge on the attempted off drive
full in length, pushed to point. Very good over from Lee, he was too quick for Lehmann, who retired some time back.
lovely slower one and Watson is completely deceived. he just pushed at it and it went past the outside edge
goes for the yorker, short of the blockhole and driven to mid-on

loud cry for lbw from Lee but Dar doesn't agree. It was full and fast, Lehmann was beaten for pace but it pitched just outside leg stump. IT would have hit the top of middle but it landed just outside leg
fuller, on the off stump, dabbed to the off side
short and angling away from Lehmann who was squared up and steered it in the air past the diving Mahela at slip
length delivery, just outside off stump, stabbed off the inside edge to the on side

Sharp catch from Piyush. Akmal had checked his on drive and Chawla ran back from mid-on, had to turn to his left as the ball dipped that side but kept his eyes on the ball and stretched his arms out in front of him and hung to the ball.
Another short delivery, Akmal is late on the pull but edges it high over the 'keeper's head. Four runs in the V behind the wicket!
on the middle, drifting towards middle and leg, turned past square leg
short of length, coming in from outside off, Watson thrusts his foot forward and pats it back to the bowler
starts off with a short one, Akmal misses a pull but will scamper across for a leg bye. Hopes slipped after the release and went down to the ground.
Full pitched, well outside off and Watson just slams it along the ground past Sreesanth. The crowd have gone delirious. It's a packed house in there.
full in length, on the off stump line, pushed back to Sreesanth who threatens to fire a throw back at the striker's end. The crowd clear their throat again. what fun!
Watson wants a piece of action. He just leaned forward and hit a length delivery high in the air and over the bowler's head.
I thought he messed up his run up but he still went through with the delivery and ended up bowling it wide down the leg side. He should have pulled out of that one
turned past square leg

Huge appeal for a catch down the leg side. Sreesanth asks Watson, "No bat? " Watson shakes his head and Sreesanth nods and walks back quietly. Watson tried to glance a length delivery and not sure whether he nicked it or it went off the thigh pad
in the zone, lovely probing delivery outside off and Watson lets it go past him
down the leg side and the crowd roar their joy. They are heckling their Indian player!
Makes amends this time with a stunning pull. He moved towards the off stump and killed a short ball over midwicket
Big swing but no wood on leather. He moved outside leg and tried to carve a full delivery outside off over point but missed it completely
Full and outside off, run down to third man. But Lee offers another free hit.
full and straight, pushed to left of mid-off
Full in length, on the middle and drifting towards leg, Yusuf tried to play a pick-up shot over square leg but got a thick leading edge and Lee settled under the skier.
banged in short and at the leg stump line, Yusuf swivels to play a neat pull shot to fine leg boundary.
full and straight, worked through midwicket for couple of runs

shuffles across, Sreesanth hits the deck short of length and keeps it straight on the middle and Akmal is hit on the pad as he attempts a short-arm pull. The ball drops in front of the stumps, Akmal thinks about a run and Sreesanth kills that thought by rushing across
fullish, drifting on to the legs and Akmal flicks it past square leg
on the stumps, defended. Sreesanth has a word or two with Akmal who doesn't like it and says something back. Yuvraj gets in to handle the hot Sreesanth

More drama as a ferocious appeal for a caught-behind dismissal is turned out. Sreesanth is really upset and fuming. It was a seaming delivery outside off, Akmal went for a drive and there was a noise there but no deviation. The snickometer doesn't show any deviation either.
Dropped by his brother Irfan at mid-on. Full and straight, Yusuf went for a lofted straight drive, didn't connect well and Irfan running to his left got his palms to it but clanged it
on a length, on the middle, defended to the leg side
slips this one down the leg side

Sreesanth strikes first ball. Kaifu is gone. Perfect seaming delivery, outside off stump and Kaif went for another on-the-up drive but edged it behind. Kaif has failed again. Sreesanth lets out a roar as Kaif walks past him.
slashed to third man. Full and outside off, Kaif freed his arms
Nice riposte. A touch short in length and Kaif punched it on the up through covers
huge shout for lbw but Tiffin turns it down. It landed on a length, angled in to strike him on top of the pad in front of middle. Close call. Aamir Sohail drawls, "Very lucky Mohammad Kaif"
short and climbing outside off, Kaif tries a upper cut but can't connect
fires it short of length, Kaif went for a pull but topedged a 'catch' to deep mid-off
length delivery, on the off stump, defended to the off side. Lee has bowled another no ball. He started the free hit in this tournament by overstepping in his previous game.
Kaif is opening. Full, on the middle and leg, drifting down and evades the waft to crash into the pad
